clips.title: The story
paras: Beyond the Clockwerk Run, the Hall of Gears lies in ruin inside Gnomeregan. Toxic sludge fills its lower floor, while oozes and irradiated troggs roam the chamber.

The Hall of Gears lies beyond the Clockwerk Run, deep in Gnomeregan’s ruined machinery halls. Its two levels show how completely the gnome capital has fallen. Irradiated troggs claw through collapsed access shafts and prowl the upper catwalks. Below, radioactive pools cover the floor, where corrosive slimes and living poison elementals thrive in the toxic runoff.

The Hall of Gears links parts of Gnomeregan’s operational quarters. From the upper walkways, paths lead to contaminated dead ends, the Clean Zone, and the Dormitory. Below, winding maintenance passages lead toward the Launch Bay. Both levels remain dangerous because of the horrors left by Mekgineer Thermaplugg’s venting scheme.
